# USB-C_Socket_FullSpeed

[![Wood](https://img.shields.io/badge/Quality-Wood-8B5E3C?style=flat-square)](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#quality-scale) ![auto-generated](https://img.shields.io/badge/auto--generated-CI-lightgrey?style=flat-square)

USB 2.0 Type-C receptacle for full-speed devices (HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12), 5.1k pulldowns on CC1/CC2 for 5V sink, 3.6V zener clamps on D+/D-. No 1.5k data pull-up: full-speed devices with an internal pull-up (CH340, RP2040, STM32) connect directly. Socket and ESD are LCSC Extended (no Basic alternative exists in the JLC catalogue); the CC resistors are Basic.

![preview](USB-C_Socket_FullSpeed_preview.svg)
